facts.text: I asked the sales coach to provide a detailed recap of each part of a sales call transcript using a sales framework.
I said I would provide the transcript of a sales call in multiple parts.
I said the transcript part 1 covers 0-10m9s out of 29m02s.
I said the call transcript includes a greeting between Matt Brown and Eric Cameron.
I said Eric Cameron is VP of People Operations.
I said Eric Cameron said the team has main locations in Austin and Chicago.
I said Eric Cameron said the Austin and Chicago locations are primarily or fully the main locations and that expansion is soon.
I said Matt Brown said he is dialing in from Canada.
I said Matt Brown said he worked for a Canadian company for years.
I said Trina Berks is a technical program manager for the business apps team.
I said Nick Sarkissian is the director of Business Applications.
I said Nick Sarkissian helps strategically manage third party apps and help the business onboard them more easily.
I said Lucas Cooper is Business Applications Manager.
I said Lucas Cooper works with Sark primarily on finance applications for logistics.
I said Lucas Cooper was brought into the call because he was using Fellow as well.
I said Eric Cameron said the organization currently uses a different system for one-on-one meetings.
I said Eric Cameron said testing out Fellow was to see what it is capable of and whether it is a platform the organization wants to move to.
I said Eric Cameron said the idea is to learn more and see what possibilities exist.
I said Eric Cameron said the organization wants to tie things in to ensure information security.
I said Eric Cameron said the organization wants to automate processes for new employees being added and employees being removed from systems.
I said Nick Sarkissian said the organization uses Okta internally.
I said Nick Sarkissian said connecting to Okta would make the IT side easier.
I said Nick Sarkissian said the organization utilizes Workday as its system.
I said Matt Brown said the company integrates directly with Okta.
I said Matt Brown said they have Workday integration.
I said Matt Brown said he would send security compliance documentation.
I said Matt Brown said there is a SOC report available behind an NDA.
I said Matt Brown said the security review team would be looped in.
I said Matt Brown said they want to deploy at the enterprise level and hash out security review to ensure it is not a barrier.
I said Eric Cameron asked what the difference is between pro and enterprise plans and what additional functionality is available.
I said Matt Brown said the pro plan is built for teams and the enterprise plan is built for company-wide deployments.
I said Matt Brown said enterprise has more robust integrations to Okta.
I said Matt Brown said enterprise includes meaning analytics.
I said Matt Brown said enterprise enables mandate, standardize, and track one-on-ones across the entire organization.
I said Matt Brown said enterprise centralizes management of one-on-ones.
I said Matt Brown said enterprise provides visibility into which managers are running and using Fellow using agendas for meetings.
I said Matt Brown said enterprise provides support for managers who might need more support.
I said Matt Brown said enterprise scales Fellow meeting functionality from one team to an entire organization.
I said Matt Brown said there is a side-by-side comparison of the plans.
I said Matt Brown said enterprise functionality is available at the scale being looked for.
I said Matt Brown said Fellow includes OKR tracking.
I said Matt Brown said embedding OKR tracking in the feedback suite is part of the offering.
I said Matt Brown said centralizing management in Fellow is preferable to having multiple providers doing review and tracking in multiple places.
I said Matt Brown said the goal is a single source of truth for OKR tracking.
I said Nick Sarkissian asked whether OKRs are user entered and whether the business can upload objectives and set them for teams.
I said Matt Brown said Fellow Analytics iteration can be for the entire organization or just a single team.
I said Matt Brown said senior leadership can import objectives within Fellow.
I said Matt Brown said visibility can be toggled so C-suite objectives can be contained within the C-suite.

events.text: Call introduction and objectives/outcome discussion among Matt Brown, Eric Cameron, Trina Berks, Nick Sarkissian, and Lucas Cooper
Discussion of security requirements and integrations with Okta and Workday
Discussion of differences between Fellow pro and enterprise plans
Discussion of OKR tracking and importing objectives with visibility toggles for C-suite
